aiDescription.summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Navy to transfer one or more F‑14 Tomcat aircraft in Navy or DoD custody to the U.S. Space and Rocket Center Commission in Huntsville, AL, by sale, gift, loan, or otherwise under terms the Secretary sets, including demilitarization, indemnification, and limits on further disposition. Transfers are at the Commission's expense, and the Commission may hire nonprofits to restore and operate the aircraft for public display, airshows, and commemorations.

impact.summary: The Maverick Act authorizes the Secretary of the Navy to transfer F-14 Tomcat aircraft from Department of the Navy or Department of Defense custody to the U.S. Space and Rocket Center Commission in Huntsville, Alabama. The Commission would bear all transfer, restoration, operation, and maintenance costs, may face demilitarization or indemnification requirements, and may partner with nonprofits to display jets at museums, airshows, and commemorations.
